title: Equal pay: Samira Ahmed
summary: A tribunal upheld Ahmed’s equal-pay claim against the BBC.

evidence.text: The tribunal found like work with Jeremy Vine and rejected the BBC’s non-discriminatory explanation for the pay difference.
evidence.label: Employment tribunal judgment, page 1

supportedFinding: A sex-equality ruling in a specific pay case.
limits: This case does not establish every BBC employee’s intent or all pay outcomes.
feedback: Keep the adverse ruling and its scope together.

title: Coverage of an antisemitic attack
summary: Ofcom distinguished online failings from the related BBC broadcast.

evidence.text: Ofcom found online accuracy and impartiality failings; the broadcast did not breach its Code. Disputed audio was not promptly acknowledged.
evidence.label: Ofcom’s published conclusions

evidence.text: The regulator preserves earlier BBC article versions and their amendments. Assess that historical version, not an assumed unchanged current page.
evidence.label: Ofcom archive of the BBC article and amendments

limits: Neither a broadcast Code breach nor deliberate racist intent was established here.
feedback: A finding about one format cannot erase the finding about another.

title: Racial slur in a news broadcast
summary: Tony Hall apologised for broadcasting a racial slur.

evidence.text: ITV reported Hall’s acknowledgement of a broadcast mistake and distress, alongside his stated intention to report an alleged racist attack.
evidence.label: ITV reporting the BBC director-general’s statement

supportedFinding: Acknowledged harmful editorial decision involving racist language.
limits: Harm and claimed intention are separate; this source is not a discrimination judgment.
feedback: A claimed good intention does not erase harm or the admitted mistake.
